identity.pass: PASS explicit sibling moves, typed keys, key reset and retirement, duplicate and invalid key authority

nested_identity.pass: PASS nested explicit modifiers and independent ForEach row and loop scopes

identity_scopes.pass: PASS wrapper and branch scopes, empty content collision, and UTF-8 key limits and equality

core.pass: PASS exact receipt, SDK routing, keyed move, branch retirement, binding provenance, mount replacement

controls.pass: PASS typed control envelopes, canceled and invalid candidates, keyed edit state, and stale authority

modifier_authority.pass: PASS disabled ancestry, typed cross-frame refusal, and keyed modifier updates

modifier_targets.pass: PASS transparent modifier targets and pre-promotion accessibility refusals

erased_identity.pass: PASS erased view lifetime, canceled type change, and retired callback refusal

environment.pass: PASS typed environment defaults, host snapshots, mount isolation, and accepted frame callbacks

layout.pass: PASS unsupported spacing and node kinds fail through SDK validation

constructs.name: `View` and builder branches
constructs.scope: Composed view bodies and conditional child lifetime

constructs.name: `HStack`
constructs.scope: Top, center, and bottom alignment. Default spacing and finite spacing in 0–256 points.

constructs.name: `List`
constructs.scope: Builder content with sections and keyed rows

constructs.name: `ForEach`
constructs.scope: Arrays with integer keys and state retained on row moves

constructs.name: `.id(_:)`
constructs.scope: Integer and bounded string keys, moves within a parent, key changes, and stale frame refusal

constructs.name: `AnyView`
constructs.scope: State and identity survive a new value of the same concrete type. An accepted type change replaces the subtree.

constructs.name: `TextField(_:text:)`
constructs.scope: Single-line string binding and Unicode edits

constructs.name: `Toggle(_:isOn:)`
constructs.scope: String label and Boolean input in both directions

constructs.name: `.disabled(_:)`
constructs.scope: Boolean subtree restriction that descendants cannot undo. Transparent groups cover every emitted root.

constructs.name: `.accessibilityLabel(_:)` and `.accessibilityHint(_:)`
constructs.scope: Verbatim strings on exactly one Text, Button, TextField, or Toggle node. A container, zero or multiple emitted nodes, or a repeated property fails before frame promotion.

constructs.name: `@State`
constructs.scope: Direct stored integer, Boolean, and string state
